answer: Require every identity to pass several independent verifiers at once — one checks device, another checks dealings, a third checks work — and no single verifier can mint an identity alone. A farmer who fools one gate still faces the others, so the cost of a fake multiplies, like copper wiring that only carries current when every strand is intact. Verifiers rotate and are paid only when verdicts survive review, so a captured verifier loses its ivory-tower licence fast. The terrace of checks stays climbable for one genuine agent, but a farm must climb it once per clone, each time from scratch.
